observations: Photo 0 shows a black Sony PS4 console with a DualShock 4 controller placed on top. The console is split into two halves, with 'SONY' on the left and 'PS4' on the right. The controller is dark gray with visible buttons and analog sticks.

Photo 1 shows the same console and controller from a different angle, placed on a brown surface. The console appears to be the same model, with 'SONY' and 'PS4' visible on the front. The controller is resting on the left side of the console.
Both photos have a watermark: 'POSTED ON Jiji NEHXT VIDEOGAMES'.
The console appears to be a standard PS4 Fat model, not a slim or Pro variant, based on its thickness and design.
No games, cables, or power supply are visible in either photo.

claims.claim: Hacked ps4 fat available with games inside

risks.proof: A screenshot of the console's home screen showing custom firmware or a modified UI, or a video demonstrating the console running unauthorized software.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not hacked, which significantly reduces value for buyers seeking a hacked system.

risks.risk: The console may be missing essential accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, disc drive, etc.) or may be damaged internally.
risks.proof: Photos of all included accessories and a video showing the console powering on and booting normally.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete or non-functional, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The 'games inside' claim may be false — the console may not have any games installed or may have only a few or outdated titles.
risks.proof: A screenshot or video showing the game library on the console's screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having no games, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Screenshot or video of the console's home screen showing custom firmware or modified UI to verify it is hacked.
Video showing the console powering on and booting normally.
Photos of all included accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, etc.).

response.reason: The console is identifiable as a PS4 Fat, but the critical claim of being 'hacked' and having 'games inside' cannot be verified from the photos. Without proof of functionality, hacking status, and included games, the item cannot be priced accurately. The risks of non-functionality or missing features are too high to price without further evidence.
